title: Pragmatic and Curious Software Developer
heroCumpliment: Thanks for stopping by and taking a look at this portfolio. I'm Alex Lambert, a software developer based in Lisbon, Portugal. I currently work with cross-functional teams to build internal platforms, business tools, and customer-facing web applications.
aboutBrief: From backend services and APIs to responsive interfaces and mobile-friendly experiences, I enjoy building software that is practical, maintainable, and genuinely useful. I care about clean architecture, continuous learning, and creating solutions that solve real problems.
aboutExtra: I'm especially interested in projects that combine strong backend foundations with thoughtful user experience. I enjoy working across different layers of an application, from data modeling and API design to frontend implementation and developer tooling. Exploring new technologies and improving my workflow is a big part of what keeps software development exciting for me.
